basePrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: faithful character turnaround reference sheet, for preserving an existing game character. The original sprite reference images show the SAME character on differently colored Othello disks; do NOT mix two different character designs. Generate ONE wide landscape PNG with exactly THREE separated full-body views: strictly FRONT, true 90-degree RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE, and strictly BACK, left to right, identical scale and consistent anatomy and equipment. Plain uniform pure WHITE empty backdrop (#FFFFFF), no checkerboard, no transparency simulation, no gradients. Remove the entire Othello disk, rim, scenery, ground plane, cast shadow, UI, and ambient effects; retain intrinsic character anatomy and essential worn or held equipment. No labels, no text, no panels, no dividing lines. Preserve original silhouette, face, head-to-body ratio, clothing, colors, materials and illustration style, do not redesign or add decorative details. Infer unseen areas conservatively from visible forms; never invent humanoid limbs for nonhumanoid subjects. Entire figure and equipment inside each view with generous separation and outer margins. Three rotations of the same character in a neutral comparable pose. All have their full lower body, except wraiths retain original flowing spectral lower body instead of invented legs.
